regime: Rising yields weighing on metals while tech rebounds, ahead of the midterm results
takeaway: Strong job openings data pushed the 10-year yield up about 6 bp to near 4.96% and lifted the dollar against the yen, which pulled gold down about 0.4%, silver nearly 2% and the gold miners about 2%. Chip stocks lifted the Nasdaq about 0.8% while oil slipped for a second day. After the close, early results showing Democratic wins sent stock futures lower and gold back above $4,000, so Wednesday could open very differently.
